correctness.rationale: The proof uses only the exact printed model (1). A weighted B-cell/plasma quantity cancels every maturation and differentiation flux and is nonincreasing, while N+H+G obeys a scalar dissipative bound, establishing global boundedness. Variation-of-constants formulas then propagate strict positivity through the finite chain to B_n and P for every positive time. Since P is nondecreasing and strictly positive after any t0>0, the exact antigen equation gives an exponential upper bound forcing V to zero.

value.rationale: The source uses failure to reach the terminal clone as the mathematical mechanism representing chronic infection. The exact ODE instead guarantees that every finite chain reaches the terminal clone immediately in the strict-positivity sense and eventually clears antigen because plasma cells accumulate without death. This changes the model's long-time biological interpretation and identifies the simulations as metastable or resolution-limited rather than genuinely persistent.
